name: Creatures
description:
The mod provides creature and war machine balance for PvP:

- Minimum map amount of Sharpshooters is increased
-AI value of Lizardmen and Lizard Warriors is increased
-Ballista cost is decreased from 2500 to 1500, base damage is increased from 2-3 to 3-4.
-Cannon cost is decreased from 4000 to 3000.

The submod includes balance changes for creatures from the following mods, if they are enabled: Tides of War, Heavenly Forge 2000, New Pavilion, Ruins Town.
author: wnukos
